answer_4.quote: We collect data from 134 people on Mechanical Turk... We structure the study as a within-subject survey with 20 two‑turn examples... Values represent Likert ratings on a scale of "strongly disagree" (1) to "strongly agree" ( )
answer_4.guideline: Within‑subject survey where participants rated each system response on a Likert scale (1–7) indicating their agreement with statements about the response.
